support.faq1.a: Taxis charge after arrival, parking & delivery are prepaid, bikes & scooters auto-charge after QR use.
support.faq2.a: You can cancel on the call screen before a driver is assigned. After assignment, please contact support.
support.faq3.q: How do I find lost items?
support.faq3.a: Select the trip in your history and file the item type and time in the lost & found center to reach the driver directly.
support.faq4.q: What if there's an emergency mid-ride?
support.faq4.a: Tap the SOS button on the call screen to send your GPS and vehicle info to the ops center. Call 112 in emergencies.
